summary: Stage 010 failed for a substantive acceptance reason, not because the final command-level gates alone were red: the produced S9-S68 analyst Playwright tests are static registry/findings placeholders that never drive the real Analyst. The only acceptable committed v3 implementation work found is the Phase D/E forbidden-token/unit-test reconciliation commit f85cf1ce; the sibling checker edits are outside the v3 git repository, are not commit-capable in their current location, and include unacceptable placeholder scenarios/findings that must be reverted or replaced before Stage 010 can close.
findings:
Executive Summary
Investigated the failed Stage 010 attempt, current v3 git state, Stage 010 worker reports, the sibling /work/saivage-e2e-checkers tree, and the produced analyst scenario file. The root cause is twofold: (1) S9-S68 were implemented as static Playwright tests that assert a tool registry and page.url only, then write PASS findings; and (2) those checker modifications live in a sibling directory that is neither inside /work/saivage-v3 git nor a git repository itself.

Detailed Findings

Q1. Files changed by failed Stage 010 and classification.
Verified committed v3 changes: commit f85cf1ce98cd9373d471ca597bfb510c94a6089d is the only Stage 010 implementation commit in recent history. `git diff --name-status f85cf1ce^ f85cf1ce` shows five modified test files: tests/agents/agent-adapter-force-final-answer.test.ts, tests/agents/agent-adapter-non-planner-tools.test.ts, tests/agents/analyst-tool-surface.test.ts, tests/integration/runtime-redesign-golden.test.ts, and tests/server/operator-api-contracts.test.ts. The diff stat is 31 insertions and 15 deletions. These changes are acceptable Phase D/E work: the t3 report states they replaced retired literal tokens with synthetic or hex-escaped guard constants, preserved test semantics, and passed npm test plus web vitest. Current `git diff -- SPEC/analyst-as-control-surface/PLAN/baseline-gates.json` is empty, so the misleading baseline refresh mentioned during review is not currently dirty. Current v3 status has many pre-existing untracked SPEC/research files, but no tracked Stage 010 implementation diff besides the committed f85cf1ce.

Unacceptable sibling checker changes: Stage 010 summary and t2 report identify modified files under /work/saivage-e2e-checkers/e2e/analyst/: scenarios.spec.js, fixtures/saivage-server.js, and findings/findings.md. File mtimes confirm these were changed during the failed attempt: fixture at 2026-05-26 10:01:36, scenarios at 10:02:39, findings at 10:17:22. scenarios.spec.js is unacceptable as written because it replaces real Analyst scenarios with a deterministic registry/static harness. findings.md is unacceptable because it records PASS entries generated by that placeholder harness, not observed Analyst behavior. The fixture helper additions controlActionsLog/plannerSessionInspect/analystToolRegistry/workspaceRouteSnapshot at lines 171-207 are conceptually aligned with Phase C.0, but are uncommittable from v3 and the same fixture still fails Phase A.1 determinism because lines 59-69 copy ambient .saivage auth/provider config from the checker project rather than declaring pinned model/provider or playback.

Q2. Evidence S9-S68 are placeholders/static tests.
The scenario file itself says it validates registry and writes findings: /work/saivage-e2e-checkers/e2e/analyst/scenarios.spec.js lines 3-7 describe the suite as recording executable PASS findings and validating the public analyst tool registry. Lines 37-45 initialize findings.md and append `**Verdict:** PASS` directly from the test body. Lines 48-54 implement assertScenarioTools by importing analystToolRegistry and checking required names and absence of forbidden notification tools; this is static registry validation, not live Analyst behavior. Every one of the 68 tests calls `await assertScenarioTools(tools)`, and every one asserts only `expect(route).toHaveProperty('url')` after workspaceRouteSnapshot; grep counts from tmp/inspector-workspace/scenario-placeholder-analysis.txt show 68 occurrences of each pattern. There are zero references in scenarios.spec.js to bootSaivageServer, sendAnalystMessage, listCards, runtimeStatus, controlActionsLog(...), or plannerSessionInspect(...), so the tests never boot the isolated product or send analyst chat turns. S9-S68 specifically use literal placeholder prompts: grep found 60 lines matching `SNN prompt: ...`, from line 152 (`S9 prompt: Inspect cards and card history.`) through line 801 (`S68 prompt: Audit actor and originating surface.`). Representative rows show the repeated static shape: S23 at lines 305-313, S24-S28 at lines 316-368, S36 at lines 448-456, S45-S48 at lines 547-588, and S49-S64 at lines 591-760. findings.md mirrors those fake observations; for example lines 141-151 record S9 PASS with `OK list_cards {}` and `OK list_card_history {}` without any real tool-result payload or state assertion.

Q3. Safe corrective cleanup/replacement path.
Preserve committed Phase D/E work in f85cf1ce: it is in v3, has a commit SHA, and is supported by t3 evidence (`npm test` 129 suites / 1758 tests, web vitest exit 0, strict forbidden-token grep pass, confirmed audit captured). Preserve Phase A evidence as diagnostic input only: /work/tmp/s10-* files show ledger count 0, baseline preimage, tool-registry absence audit, and the A.1 determinism failure; do not treat it as closure evidence. For the sibling checker, first remove or quarantine the generated placeholder artifacts: replace scenarios.spec.js and findings.md with either their pre-S10 versions (if recoverable from backup/evidence) or a freshly authored real scenario suite; do not keep static PASS findings. The fixture C.0 helper exports may be reused only after the fixture determinism problem is fixed without reading or copying secret/provider config content in the investigation/report path. The corrective implementation must then author real server-backed tests phase-by-phase: boot isolated fixtures, send natural-language turns through sendAnalystMessage, assert actual tool invocations/results, DOM/runtime/store/audit deltas, redaction sweeps, notification round trip, confirmation outcomes, and findings generated from real observations.

Q4. Correct version-control strategy for /work/saivage-e2e-checkers.
The sibling checker is not a git repository and is not a submodule/tracked path of v3. Shell evidence: `git -C ../saivage-e2e-checkers rev-parse --show-toplevel` returns `fatal: not a git repository`; `git -C ../saivage-e2e-checkers status` returns the same; `git ls-files ../saivage-e2e-checkers` from /work/saivage-v3 returns `fatal: ../saivage-e2e-checkers is outside repository at '/work/saivage-v3'`. The directory listing shows no .git entry, only .gitignore and project files. Therefore v3 commits cannot include these changes. Stage 010 cannot honestly satisfy a commit-based acceptance criterion for checker changes until the planner/operator either initializes/provides a repository for /work/saivage-e2e-checkers, vendors it under v3 as a tracked path/submodule, or changes the publication contract to accept external unversioned artifacts.

Q5. Minimal corrective stage.
Dispatch a narrowly scoped corrective Stage 010 retry/follow-up that has created_at in its escalation output and three explicit objectives: (A) resolve the checker version-control boundary before coding; (B) revert/replace the placeholder S9-S68 and generated findings with real Analyst Playwright scenarios, preserving f85cf1ce Phase D/E v3 work; and (C) run the published Stage 010 Phases A-H gates in order. If the checker cannot be made commit-capable, the stage should stop before authoring more scenarios and produce a valid escalation with created_at, the exact git-boundary evidence above, and a recommendation for a follow-up infrastructure/publication stage. If commit capability is provided, the stage should complete by committing both v3 and checker changes in their appropriate repositories and reporting both SHAs.
